_readme: Template identity and placeholder values. Projects that use this template replace the values with their own; keep the template id equal to the folder name.

extraTools._readme: Project-specific tool IDs merged into every agent and prompt 'tools:' list AFTER each template sync (scripts/Update-FromTemplate.ps1) and at init time, so your custom MCP servers survive the refresh that overwrites those files. 'all' applies to every agent + prompt; 'agents'/'prompts' add per-file extras keyed by file name without extension (e.g. 'bc-dev', 'onboard-app'). Additive only - tools are never removed. Prefer generic namespaces (e.g. 'al/*'); purely machine-local servers can instead just be toggled per-session in VS Code's tool picker.
